Synopsis:
Putin declared Russia is winning in Ukraine, dismissed mobilization rumors, and labeled Ukrainian leadership "terrorists" unfit for negotiation — while paradoxically signaling openness to Trump-mediated talks. He confirmed Ukrainian drone damage to Russian refineries but claimed 90% repaired. Russia is advancing toward Sloviansk and Kramatorsk, with two Ukrainian troop groupings allegedly encircled. Putin also dismissed German accusations over the Leipzig airport drone attack as a domestic distraction. The war is now 4.5 years old; US-mediated peace talks collapsed in February following a US-Israel conflict with Iran. Growing Russian war fatigue and economic strain noted but downplayed by Putin.
